rules.statement: Flags are pessimistic: full and empty may be late to deassert but must never deassert early.
The storage is a separate module instantiated in the top, its write port in the write domain and its read port in the read domain.
The write domain accepts i_wr_data and drives the memory write port with enable, address (low LPARA_ADDR_W bits of binary write pointer) and data, storing the word.
The binary write pointer increments, its Gray code is registered, and the Gray pointer crosses to the read domain.
After S read-clock stages of the selected cell the read domain sees the new write Gray pointer and updates empty from it.
o_rd_data always shows the word at the read address (show-ahead).
The read domain accepts a read, increments the read pointer so o_rd_data shows the next word, and registers the Gray code.
The read Gray pointer crosses to the write domain, which after the synchronizer latency sees it, updates full and frees the entry for a new write.
i_rst_n_sw starts a handshake blocking both interfaces, resets the read pointer first and the write pointer after the acknowledge, and releases the read side before the write side.
The storage read port is synchronous and is read every read-clock cycle.
The read-domain storage output register may capture an unsettled word only while the FIFO is empty, and the word is captured again before o_empty falls.
The read data from the storage returns to the read module.
The number of stored words (write pointer minus read pointer modulo 2 x depth) stays between 0 and PARA_AFIFO_DEPTH.
full and empty are never both 1.
A Gray pointer register changes at most one bit per clock cycle.
The write side must not overwrite an entry not yet read, and the read side must not read an entry not yet written, per registered flags.

rules.condition: a write rejected (overflow) or read rejected (underflow)
rules.statement: A rejected write or read leaves pointers and storage unchanged.

rules.condition: when a side leaves software reset
rules.statement: At the instant a side leaves software reset, its own pointer and its synchronized copy of the other pointer are both 0.
